_meta.description: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003 — Rules applicable to Institutional & Educational / Healthcare Buildings

rules.title: Minimum Plot Area for Institutional Use
rules.error_message: Plot area {actual} sqm is below the minimum {expected} sqm required for institutional buildings.
rules.recommendation: Institutional developments require at least 500 sqm plot area to accommodate public gathering space.
rules.explanation: Schools, hospitals, and public facilities require significant open ground area for safety and assembly.

rules.title: Minimum Abutting Road Width for Institutional
rules.error_message: Abutting road width {actual} m is below minimum {expected} m for institutional access.
rules.recommendation: Provide at least 12.0 m road width for emergency vehicle access and student/patient transport.
rules.explanation: Ensures buses, ambulances, and emergency vehicles have unrestricted access.
